## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain why cross-pollination matters, and how plants balance it
  against the reliability of self-pollination
- Describe the flower as a marketplace: distinguish signal from
  reward, and signal from cue
- Give examples of floral rewards beyond nectar, and explain what
  each one actually costs the plant
- Explain the plant-pollinator "game" — honest signals, deception,
  nectar robbing, and nursery pollination — and how it plays out over
  both micro- and macroevolutionary time
- Use the caffeine-in-nectar story to explain how even a genuine
  reward can double as manipulation
